notes: Merged five fat-level kinds (Double, Single, Whipping, Thickened, Aerosol whipped cream) into one Cream kind. The fat levels are now types. Cream keeps the Double cream source (trolley.co.uk). Kept the existing single and whipping cream models. Moved Land O'Lakes Mini Moos half-and-half singles from Single cream to Dairy creamer, because it is a portion creamer. Clotted cream and kaymak are combined, with the two as types. The PDO/GI entries (Cornish clotted cream, Afyon kaymağı, Crème de Bresse) are kept as maker-less models listed first. Removed 'Smetana' as a model and made it a type of Soured cream & smetana. In Dairy creamer, the South Asian whitener models went from 8 to 5 brand entries (with Nestlé Everyday as a sixth whitener line). The separate India and Pakistan Nestlé Everyday entries are merged into one Nestlé line. Dropped Milma Day to Day as a regional (Kerala) co-operative line covered by the national brands. No archetypes, new kinds or brand entries were added. No web research was done, so the existing sources are retained as they were.
